evals.expected_output: Skill picks review-playlist (user said 'reviewen'), defaults to dry-run, renders the planned command using .venv/bin/python from repo root, quotes the URL.

Default mode is dry-run, with execute offered as an explicit second choice
Planned command uses '.venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py review-playlist'
